headline: SecMark to establish a new wholly owned subsidiary
hook: SecMark board approves new subsidiary incorporation
summary: SecMark's Board of Directors approved the incorporation of a new wholly owned subsidiary on November 5, 2026. This move aligns with SEBI (LODR) disclosure requirements. The company has not yet disclosed the specific business purpose or capital allocation for this new entity.
whats_next: Details on the subsidiary's business operations and capital infusion.
why_it_matters: Corporate restructuring may signal future expansion or business diversification.

headline: Secmark Consultancy plans Rs 48 crore investment for subsidiary mineral exchange
summary: Secmark Consultancy's board approved an investment of up to Rs 48 crore in its wholly-owned subsidiary Markets on Cloud Private Limited or a newly incorporated subsidiary. The funds will be utilized to establish a mineral exchange. Additionally, the company released its standalone and consolidated unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. Indian retail investors holding Secmark shares should note this strategic diversification into a new business segment.
why_it_matters: New subsidiary investment expands business lines for shareholders
